description: Implementation of the MasqueClient class for managing QUIC MASQUE protocol sessions, including connection setup, session creation, and settings handling.

classes.name: MasqueClient
classes.description: A client class for managing MASQUE protocol sessions over QUIC, including connection setup, session management, and settings handling.

methods.name: MasqueClient
methods.description: Constructor initializing the MasqueClient with server address, server ID, mode, event loop, proof verifier, and URI template.

methods.name: CreateQuicClientSession
methods.description: Creates and returns a new MasqueClientSession for the supported QUIC versions and connection.

methods.name: connection_id
methods.description: Retrieves the connection ID from the current MasqueClientSession.

methods.name: authority
methods.description: Constructs and returns the authority string based on the URI template.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Static method to create and initialize a MasqueClient, resolving address, establishing connection, and performing setup.

methods.name: OnSettingsReceived
methods.description: Marks that settings have been received.

methods.name: WaitUntilSettingsReceived
methods.description: Blocks until settings are received or connection is lost.
